scope: P4 ordinary conversation ownership through the actual legacy exec composition on synthetic data
verified: Real public legacy exec emits two loopback SSE requests and one normal 26-token billing row, with the observed authorized file effect and exactly one matching Evidence reference.
The Rust Store denies acquisition while the legacy owner is active, and can acquire after the recorded stop.
SIGTERM during real SSE preserves an observed five tokens and closes the original owner while retaining unknown usage. macOS also explicitly reran the cancellation-exit-code assertion.
Unsupported tool selection, missing isolated marker and configured Hooks are refused before opening a conversation. The unflagged legacy route remains usable.
limits: Explicit fixture flag, marker, chat mode and write_file only. The experiment exercises compatibility with the legacy binary. The deliverable native CLI does not call that binary.
Current production legacy tool ownership, Shell/MCP/Hook drain, compaction persistence, existing installed processes and P4 acceptance are open.
Synthetic provider and data only. No install, update, release, default entry change or user-data mutation.
